## About
Pacific Custom Paint & Body is a paint and body shop on Oak Hill Ln in Austin. We handle the kind of work people bring in after a bad day: a branch on the roof, a dinged bumper, paint that needs matching.
Customers tell us they notice the small things. Cars come back cleaned, questions get answered without anyone talking down to you, and when something comes up mid-job, we work through it with you.
If your insurance is involved, our office can do much of the back and forth with the insurance company so you don't have to. Give us a call and tell us what happened.

## Services
- Body shop: Body work for damage like a fallen branch on a roof rail.
- Paint work: Paint on specialty parts, including carbon fiber hoods, with fitment brought as close to factory as possible.
- Touch up paint and decals: Touch up paint and decal kits. When a vendor came up short on decals, we made the missing ones.

## FAQ
Q: Can I text a photo of the damage to get an idea of the repair?
A: One customer texted a photo of his bumper and got a call back walking through the full analysis. Call us and ask about sending a photo.

Q: What if something seems wrong after my repair?
A: Bring it back and we'll take a look. If it's something we missed, we'll take care of it.
